name: Ramp Data
description: Ramp Data MCP enables Claude users to access Ramp Data from billions of dollars in real corporate spend across 50,000+ businesses, including Ramp Rate (vendor adoption, pricing, and switching trends) and the AI Index (how businesses are spending on AI). Ramp Data is used by founders, procurement leads, researchers, investors, and policy analysts and is cited by leading publications like NYT, WSJ, Bloomberg, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ramp Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ramp Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ramp.com/ramp-data/anthropic/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Ramp Data MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Ramp Data scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ramp Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ramp Data provides these MCP tools: ramp_rate_list_categories, ramp_rate_get_category_summary, ramp_rate_get_category_vendors, ramp_rate_resolve_vendor, ramp_rate_get_vendor_profile, ramp_rate_compare_vendors, ai_index_get_adoption, ai_index_get_adoption_by_sector, and ai_index_get_adoption_by_size.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ramp Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ramp Data in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Trade It.

_published_faq.name: Does Ramp Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ramp Data does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Ramp Data is developed by Ramp. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
